_README.description: Model metadata for X.AI (GROK) API access.
_README.usage: Models listed here are exposed directly through the X.AI provider. Aliases are case-insensitive.

field_descriptions.aliases: Array of short names users can type instead of the full model name
field_descriptions.context_window: Total number of tokens the model can process (input + output combined)
field_descriptions.max_output_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response
field_descriptions.max_thinking_tokens: Maximum reasoning/thinking tokens the model will allocate when extended thinking is requested
field_descriptions.supports_extended_thinking: Whether the model supports extended reasoning tokens
field_descriptions.supports_json_mode: Whether the model can guarantee valid JSON output
field_descriptions.supports_function_calling: Whether the model supports function/tool calling
field_descriptions.supports_images: Whether the model can process images/visual input
field_descriptions.max_image_size_mb: Maximum total size in MB for all images combined
field_descriptions.supports_temperature: Whether the model accepts temperature parameter in API calls
field_descriptions.temperature_constraint: Type of temperature constraint: 'fixed' (fixed value), 'range' (continuous range), 'discrete' (specific values), or omit for default range
field_descriptions.use_openai_response_api: Set to true when the model must use the /responses endpoint (reasoning models like GPT-5.2 Pro). Leave false/omit for standard chat completions.
field_descriptions.default_reasoning_effort: Default reasoning effort level for models that support it (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high'). Omit if not applicable.
field_descriptions.intelligence_score: 1-20 human rating used as the primary signal for auto-mode model ordering
field_descriptions.allow_code_generation: Whether this model can generate and suggest fully working code

_README.catalog_provenance_2026_08_12: Verified against GET https://api.x.ai/v1/models on 2026-08-12: every entry below returns 200, and no callable xAI text model is missing. Pruned on 2026-08-12 because all their slugs return 404: the grok-2* and grok-3* families (xAI retired grok-3 effective 2026-05-15, grok-2 earlier), plus grok-beta and grok-vision-beta. Requests for a pruned slug now fail fast with 'not available with current API keys' rather than 404ing at the API. Two naming notes: (1) the three grok-4.20 entries are keyed by their '-beta-' alias form rather than xAI's canonical grok-4.20-0309-* IDs - both resolve, so this is cosmetic, but do not assume model_name here is the canonical upstream ID; (2) grok-code-fast-1 was NOT retired - it was renamed to grok-build-0.1 and its old slugs remain live aliases upstream.

models.description: Grok 4.6 (released 2026-08-12) - SpaceXAI flagship for code and everything else. Built on Grok 4.5 with a longer supplemental training run plus improved SFT/RL; tuned for long-running agents and visual/interactive work. Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 61 (vs 56 for Grok 4.5), CursorBench v3.2 69.9%, DeepSWE v1.1 65.9%. 500K context, text+image input, configurable reasoning effort. $2/$6 per 1M tokens (doubles to $4/$12 for prompts >=200K tokens). Knowledge cutoff 2026-02-01.

Grok 4.5 (released 2026-07-08) - Previous flagship, superseded by Grok 4.6 for general/agentic use. Best-in-class agentic tool calling at release (Terminal-Bench 2.1 83.3%), $2/$6 per 1M tokens. 500K context, text+image input (no video input - use grok-4.3 for 1M context).

Grok 4.3 - Superseded by Grok 4.5/4.6 for general/agentic use but retained as the long-context option: 1M context, text+image input, $1.25/$2.50 per 1M tokens. Configurable reasoning effort (none/low/medium/high).
Grok 4.20 Beta Reasoning - Older xAI flagship with extended reasoning, 1M context, text+image input, $1.25/$2.50 per 1M tokens
Grok 4.20 Beta Non-Reasoning - Direct responses without thinking, 1M context, text+image input, $1.25/$2.50 per 1M tokens
Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent Beta - Multi-agent orchestration variant, 1M context, text+image input, $1.25/$2.50 per 1M tokens

Grok Build 0.1 - Speed/cost-optimized agentic coding model (the renamed successor to grok-code-fast-1, whose slugs alias here upstream). 256K context, text+image input, $1/$2 per 1M tokens (doubles above 200K prompt tokens).
